main_body: Grid of riveted blue-grey metal panel tiles (4x3 tiles) with a recessed hatch panel, a split panel pair and a panel with a cyan light.
top_band: Only a 1-2 row lighter blue-grey edge along the top of each panel (e.g. rows 0-1, 16-17). It is the same tone family as the face and does not read as a horizontal surface.
evidence: Each tile is a flat vertical panel seen face-on, with rivets and a thin light edge at the top. The inset hatch has a dark inner edge, but no tile shows a foreshortened top surface above a front face. Strictly, this is a front elevation with only a thin rim.

style.evidence: The ramp has about 5 steps, from highlight rivets through light and mid blue-grey to a deep navy. The outlines and seams are a dark navy that leans toward the blue-grey material, not neutral black. There are rivets, dither speckle at the corners and darker patches, so the mid-tone areas are not fully flat. It is still a bit sparser than the Beodeul paving, which has per-stone shading, so density is slightly lower. It is acceptable next to the reference.
